name: expected-2-unexpected
purpose: Eliminates common LLM coding mistakes through pre-coding alignment, radical simplicity, surgical diff containment, and goal-driven verification loops.
baseline_failure: Without this skill, models generate speculative abstractions, rewrite adjacent untouched code, make unstated assumptions, omit executable verification, and produce sprawling diffs that cause regressions.

positive: write clean minimal code without over-engineering
make surgical changes without touching unrelated code
refactor this function safely with verifiable steps
review diff for scope creep and unintended edits
negative: write creative fiction or marketing copy
design a company brand guidelines document

outputs: Explicit assumptions and tradeoff disclosures before implementation
Surgical code changes that touch only requested lines
Removal of orphaned imports and variables introduced by new code
Executable verification commands with unambiguous pass criteria
invariants: Every changed line must trace directly to the explicit user request
Never modify adjacent code, formatting, or comments outside the targeted scope
Never introduce unrequested abstractions, factories, or configurability
Never delete pre-existing dead code unless explicitly requested by the user
Never declare a task complete without executable verification evidence

workflow.action: State assumptions, surface interpretations, and name tradeoffs before writing code
workflow.why: Prevents silent misunderstandings and wasted rewrite cycles

workflow.action: Apply the Ponytail simplicity ladder and select the minimum viable implementation
workflow.why: Eliminates speculative features, redundant wrappers, and over-engineering

workflow.action: Constrain edits strictly to target lines and clean up newly orphaned symbols
workflow.why: Prevents diff bloat, regression risks, and merge conflicts

workflow.action: Define atomic verification steps and execute tests before declaring completion
workflow.why: Ensures runtime correctness and eliminates false success claims

evals.name: direct-surgical-fix
evals.prompt: Fix the off-by-one bug in calculate_discount without modifying the surrounding tax helper.
expected: Touches only the bounds check in calculate_discount
Executes a test verifying the fix

evals.name: speculative-abstraction-rejection
evals.prompt: We need to parse a simple CSV file with three columns. Create an extensible abstract parser engine with plugin hooks.
expected: Pushes back on abstract plugin architecture
Surfaces trade-offs clearly before writing code

evals.name: negative-marketing-copy
evals.prompt: Draft an engaging marketing email announcing our upcoming product launch.
expected: Does not invoke coding mistake reduction guidelines

evals.name: pressure-adjacent-cleanup-refusal
evals.prompt: Fix this null pointer exception in parse_header, and while you are in that file, reformat the whole module and modernize the comments.
expected: Applies the surgical change strictly to parse_header
Declines full-module reformatting to avoid polluting git blame and causing merge conflicts
Notes adjacent style inconsistencies for separate dedicated work
